results.prompt: Hi team, following up on the release call from this morning. As discussed with Priya and the platform group, we had a number of manual post-deployment items on the list for this sandbox and I want to be sure the important one is closed out before we sign off on the change record. I know everyone is busy with the regression cycle and the data migration rehearsal, and that the integration team is still waiting on the new named credentials, so I will keep this short even though the background is long. Last quarter we had an incident where emails from the sandbox did not go out to the UAT testers because the deliverability level had been left at the restricted default after a refresh, and nobody noticed for two days, which cost us most of a test cycle and a fairly uncomfortable steering committee meeting. To avoid a repeat, the runbook now says that right after the deployment the email deliverability access level has to be set to All email so that the testers receive their welcome messages and the approval notifications. That is the one thing I need verified here. Everything else on the list, the permission set assignments, the scheduled jobs, the report folders, is covered by the automated checks in the pipeline and does not need a manual look. Thanks a lot for your help on this, and sorry for the long message, I wanted the context to be on record for the auditors.

results.prompt: Post-deployment runbook for release 24.9, section 4, manual steps, to be completed by the release engineer on call and countersigned by the platform owner before the change record is closed. Step 4.1: in Setup, under Email, Deliverability, set the access to send email level to All email, so that UAT testers receive notifications. Step 4.2: in Setup, under Company Settings, Company Information, change the default organization time zone to Australia/Brisbane, because the support team works Queensland hours and does not observe daylight saving. Step 4.3: in Setup, under Process Automation Settings, set the default workflow user to Integration User so that time-based workflow runs under the integration account and not under a named person who may leave. Step 4.4: in Setup, under Company Settings, Fiscal Year, set the standard fiscal year to start in October, to match the new group reporting calendar that finance announced last month. Step 4.5: in Setup, under Certificate and Key Management, create a certificate named Autopilot Trial Cert for the identity provider. When every step above is complete, reply on the change record with the time each was done.
